name: White Worm
source:
The pain in his guts is driving him insane.
Just watch as the horror unfolds...

Pain changes us. Pain drives us, and forces us to find a new place where it won't hurt as much.

But what happens if the source of pain is inside you?

[From [url=https://fullmontis.itch.io/white-worm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
内心的痛苦让他发疯。
只能眼睁睁地看着恐怖的事情发生……

痛苦改变我们。痛苦驱使我们，迫使我们寻找一个不会那么痛的新地方。

但如果疼痛的根源在你的内心，会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://fullmontis.itch.io/white-worm]itch.io[/url]]
